create_patch_from_code: create a git patch string from Python code for a new test_issue.py file
eval_instance: evaluate a test script against a SWE-RL episode to verify issue reproduction
SWERLConfig: create a SWERLConfig dataclass to configure context size, timeouts, and thinking mode for the environment
SWERLToolEnv_start: start a SWERLToolEnv episode with issue description and repository arguments to initialize the dialog
SWERLToolEnv_step: step through a SWERLToolEnv episode by applying tool calls and collecting feedback from the modal backend
